'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Angelo Consoli DS Imperial Entanglements''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Angelo Consoli]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Username '''Gravity Shadow'''. Line 36–37 '''Blizzard 2 (V)''' / '''Blizzard 4 (V)''' as sheet shorthand; line 39 '''Victory''' → Victory-Class Star Destroyer (V).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Entanglements|Imperial Entanglements (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Gravity Shadow
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
